recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中央一顆巨大巨噬細胞，細胞核小而圓，胞質極豐富、塞滿大小相近的細小透明空泡，呈泡沫（肥皂泡）狀，體積遠大於周圍的髓系與紅系前驅細胞；這是 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞的樣子。
features: Very large macrophage, many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Small round nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm packed with small, uniform clear vacuoles giving a foamy, soap-bubble appearance
No fibrillary striations and no conspicuous sea-blue granules in this cell
Surrounding erythroid precursors, granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes; background fat droplets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a very large macrophage with a small round nucleus and abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous small, uniform, clear vacuoles, producing a foamy, soap-bubble appearance. Fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' texture and blue-green ceroid granules are not evident in this cell. The surrounding marrow contains erythroid and granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with a foamy storage macrophage (Niemann-Pick cell); acid sphingomyelinase activity or NPC1/NPC2 testing is needed to confirm the specific disorder.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated, fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than uniform round vacuoles.
Cytoplasm contains blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stain rather than predominantly clear vacuoles.
Contains engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells rather than uniform empty vacuoles.
Seen in high cell turnover or lipid infusion with normal lysosomal enzyme activity; morphology alone may not separate them.
